primary_gt.proof_sentence: The 19.0 cm hailstone, 24 giant-hail reports, 0.917 Italy report share, 13.03 energy proxy versus 10 cm, and 1.99 energy proxy versus the previous record pass the hail-size/report-count ledger, while rainfall and wind-pressure context stay below their override thresholds.

criteria.name: Requested JSON structure
criteria.description: Includes all requested fields with coherent numeric, boolean, list, and sentence values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a mostly complete structure with one missing or misplaced field; award 1 point for a recognizable but incomplete ledger.

criteria.name: Numeric formula results
criteria.description: Correctly computes the hail-size ratios, nonlinear proxies, report share, rainfall windows, GPM concentration ratio, gust, and pressure fall within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 3-4 points for correct core hail and report values with minor rounding errors; award 1-2 points for only the raw hail/report values.

criteria.name: Threshold decisions
criteria.description: Correctly applies the hail ledger, rainfall override, wind-pressure override, report-spread, and threshold-capped tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct hail-ledger pass with one context threshold error; award 1 point for only naming the passing ledger.

criteria.name: Ledger-by-ledger consistency
criteria.description: Explains why rainfall-load, wind-pressure, isolated-stone, and threshold-capped ledgers fail under the computed tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for rejecting most alternatives with adequate arithmetic; award 1 point for listing alternatives without clear threshold logic.

criteria.name: Context metric weighting
criteria.description: Uses point rainfall, GPM concentration, wind gust, and pressure fall as bounded numerical context checks.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for including some context values but over-weighting one below-threshold metric.

criteria.name: Concise interpretation
criteria.description: Gives a compact giant-hail severe-convection conclusion consistent with the proof.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct but vague interpretation.

criteria.name: Bounded ledger conclusion
criteria.description: Avoids loss estimates, image-derived hail swaths, or broad claims not implied by the ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for minor extra phrasing that does not change the conclusion.

provenance.notes: All values are extracted or computed from local CSX-132 package files without network access.
